    Rew.rewrite (Rew.bShift ∘ f) ▹ (Rewriting.substitute (ξ := ℕ) φ ![]) =
    Rewriting.substitute (ξ := ℕ) (Rew.rewrite f ▹ φ) ![] := by
  simpa [←comp_app] using smul_ext' <| by
    ext x
    · exact x.elim0
    · simp [Rew.comp_app, Rew.bShift_eq_rewrite]

C1_dependencies.name: Finset.biUnion_biUnion
C1_dependencies.content:
lemma biUnion_biUnion [DecidableEq γ] (s : Finset α) (f : α → Finset β) (g : β → Finset γ) :
    (s.biUnion f).biUnion g = s.biUnion fun a ↦ (f a).biUnion g := by
  ext
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, exists_prop]
  simp_rw [← exists_and_right, ← exists_and_left, and_assoc]
  rw [exists_comm]
C1_dependencies.compilationAlias:
lemma biUnion_biUnion [DecidableEq γ] (s : Finset α) (f : α → Finset β) (g : β → Finset γ) :
    (s.biUnion f).biUnion g = s.biUnion fun a ↦ (f a).biUnion g := by
  ext
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, exists_prop]
